examples.question_text: A person has a BAC of $0.12$ when drinking stops. Use $t=\dfrac{\text{BAC}}{0.015}$ to estimate the time in hours for their BAC to reach zero.
A person has a BAC of $0.047$ when drinking stops. Estimate the time for their BAC to reach zero. Answer in hours and minutes to the nearest minute.
examples.solution_text:
$\begin{align*}t&=\frac{\text{BAC}}{0.015}\\&=\frac{0.047}{0.015}\\&=3.1333\ldots\text{ hours}\end{align*}$

Convert the fractional hour to minutes.

$\begin{align*}&\mathrel{\phantom{=}}0.1333\ldots\times60\\&=8\text{ minutes}\end{align*}$

The estimated time is $3\text{ hours }8\text{ minutes}$.

examples.question_text: Daniel is a $72\text{ kg}$ male who consumes $5$ standard drinks over $2\text{ hours}$. Use $\text{BAC}_{\text{male}}=\dfrac{10N-7.5H}{6.8M}$ and $t=\dfrac{\text{BAC}}{0.015}$ to estimate the time after drinking stops for his BAC to reach zero. Answer in hours and minutes to the nearest minute.
examples.solution_text:
$\begin{align*}\text{BAC}_{\text{male}}&=\frac{10N-7.5H}{6.8M}\\&=\frac{10(5)-7.5(2)}{6.8(72)}\\&=\frac{35}{489.6}\end{align*}$

Use the unrounded BAC to calculate the waiting time.

$\begin{align*}t&=\frac{\text{BAC}}{0.015}\\&=\frac{35/489.6}{0.015}\\&=4.7657\ldots\text{ hours}\end{align*}$

Convert the fractional hour to minutes.

$\begin{align*}&\mathrel{\phantom{=}}0.7657\ldots\times60\\&=45.9477\ldots\text{ minutes}\\&\approx46\text{ minutes}\end{align*}$

The estimated waiting time after drinking stops is $4\text{ hours }46\text{ minutes}$.

examples.question_text: Leah is a $60\text{ kg}$ female who consumes $4$ standard drinks over $2.5\text{ hours}$. Use $\text{BAC}_{\text{female}}=\dfrac{10N-7.5H}{5.5M}$ and $t=\dfrac{\text{BAC}}{0.015}$ to estimate the time after drinking stops for her BAC to reach zero. Answer in hours and minutes to the nearest minute.
examples.solution_text:
$\begin{align*}\text{BAC}_{\text{female}}&=\frac{10N-7.5H}{5.5M}\\&=\frac{10(4)-7.5(2.5)}{5.5(60)}\\&=\frac{21.25}{330}\end{align*}$

Use the unrounded BAC to calculate the waiting time.

$\begin{align*}t&=\frac{\text{BAC}}{0.015}\\&=\frac{21.25/330}{0.015}\\&=4.2929\ldots\text{ hours}\end{align*}$

Convert the fractional hour to minutes.

$\begin{align*}&\mathrel{\phantom{=}}0.2929\ldots\times60\\&=17.5757\ldots\text{ minutes}\\&\approx18\text{ minutes}\end{align*}$

The estimated waiting time after drinking stops is $4\text{ hours }18\text{ minutes}$.
